## _______________________________________________________________________________
## HOSPITALIZED DUE TO COVID-19
Refer to COVID-19 Pharmacological Inpatient Treatment Guidelines to determine
whether monotherapy or combination therapy with remdesivir and dexamethasone is
appropriate. For patients on dexamethasone with rapidly increasing oxygen needs
and systemic inflammation, add a second immunomodulatory drug (see
Immunomodulatory Treatment below)
[Minneapolis VAHCS COVID Pharmacologic Inpatient Treatment Guidelines](orz-gtx-abx-covid-19-pharmacologic-inpt-treatment-guidelines)
## Remdesivir (IV):
[Remdesivir 200mg IV once on day 1, then 100mg IV daily for 4 additional days](orz-set-abx-remdesivir-200mg-load-then-100mg-q24h-5days)
< AND >
[Lab orders for monitoring remdesivir treatment (CMP, CBC with diff, INR)](lrtz-set-remdesivir-x5-days)
## Dexamethasone (PO/IV):
[Dexamethasone 6 MG PO q24h for up to 10 days](psjzid-dexamethasone-6mg-po-qday-for-10days-covid)
< OR >
[Dexamethasone 6 MG IV q24h for up to 10 days](psjzid-dexamethasone-6mg-iv-push-q24h-for-10days-covid)
## Immunomodulatory Treatment
MVAHCS recommends baricitinib over tocilizumab in patients on high flow nasal
cannula oxygen or non-invasive ventilated patients that can take PO or NG. For
patients who cannot take PO or NG, or for those who are mechanically ventilated,
we recommend tocilizumab. These treatments are to be added on to dexamethasone,
with or without remdesivir. Consult Infectious Diseases for more details.
[Baricitinib PO/NG/GT](orzid2-gmenu-abx-baricitinib-eua-covid-19)
<OR>
Tocilizumab IV
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## HOSPITALIZED FOR REASONS OTHER THAN COVID-19
Treatment is recommended for patients with confirmed mild to moderate COVID-19
and are at high risk of progressing to severe COVID-19.
[Interaction checker for COVID-19 medications website link](orz-gtx-abx-url-covid-19-med-interaction-checker)
## Preferred treatment, within 5 days of symptom onset:
## Inpatient

Paxlovid order sets below contain both inpatient and outpatient orders.
NORMAL RENAL FUNCTION (eGFR =/> 60 mL/min)
[Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days](orz-set-abx-paxlovid-inpt-and-opt-orders)
MODERATE RENAL IMPAIRMENT (eGFR 30 to < 60 mL/min)
[Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 150mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days](orz-set-abx-paxlovid-renal-dosing-pharmacy-info)
SEVERE RENAL IMPAIRMENT including hemodialysis (eGFR < 30 mL/min)
[Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg once on day 1 then](orz-set-abx-paxlovid-severe-renal-dosing-pharmacy-info)
150mg/100mg daily for 4 days
## Alternative, within 7 days of symptom onset:
[Remdesivir 200mg IV once on day 1, then 100mg IV daily for 2 additional days](orz-set-abx-remdesivir-200mg-iv-load-then-100mg-q24hh-3days)
< AND >
Lab orders for monitoring remdesivir treatment (CMP, CBC with diff, INR) ##Outpatient Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-nirmatrelver-300mg-ritonavir-100mg-po-bid-5ds)
MODERATE RENAL IMPAIRMENT (eGFR 30 to < 60 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 150mg/100mg PO BID for 5 days
Non-VA order for above
SEVERE RENAL IMPAIRMENT including hemodialysis (eGFR <30 mL/min)
Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) 300mg/100mg once on day 1 then
150mg/100mg daily for 4 days
Non-VA order for above
